name: What preparation do I need to do before kitchen flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before kitchen flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation begins, you'll need to clear out all appliances, furniture, and personal items from your kitchen. It's also advisable to remove existing flooring if you are planning a full replacement, though some new flooring types can be installed over existing surfaces. Discussing these specific preparation steps with our team during the initial consultation ensures a smooth start to the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for kitchen flooring installation by clearing out appliances and furniture, and potentially removing old flooring.
